note: Upstream no longer updated; pin tracked by Renovate, last release date in README.
Pin managed by Renovate; merging a pin bump triggers the rebuild.
No upstream releases/tags - weekly sha-check (forage.yml), sha-tagged builds.

Derived, not source-built: the upstream image packages a prebuilt musl binary and ships NO git, so the coding harness could edit a worktree but never commit. This overlay starts from the upstream image and adds git. Keep the caller's UPSTREAM_TAG build-arg (drop the leading 'v') in step with `version` — Renovate bumps the pin, the build-arg is manual.
